reason: E1 shows active learning of MTPs for refractory MPEA properties but does not address free energies, fusion, or the analytical model. E2 is a classical MD study on thermal conductivity, providing no support for any premise. The key premises thus lack specific prior evidence.
premises: Moment tensor potentials (MTPs) can be actively learned to emulate ab initio potential energy surfaces for refractory MPEAs
MTPs capture anharmonic vibrational behavior and electron–vibration coupling effects
An analytical free-energy model can explicitly retain vibrational entropy, anharmonicity, and electron–vibration coupling
Coupling MTPs with an analytical model reduces computational cost by at least an order of magnitude vs. TOR-TILD/ab initio MD
The approach yields fusion free energies within ~5% of explicit ab initio MD
